definitions.full: H478. Elishaphat אֱלִישָׁפָט proper name, masculine ( God has judged , Phoenician שפטבעל בעלשפט, ) a captain in the time of Jehoiada 2Chr 23:1 . אֱלִיָּתָה see אֱלִיאָתָה . אֶלְמוֺדָד see below I. אַל .

occurrences.englishText: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into a covenant with him.
